title: North: AI Print on Demand: A Shopify App that let's you print on demand | Product Hunt
excerpt: North makes it easy to launch a premium print-on-demand apparel brand with no inventory or production equipment. Use built-in AI to create designs, publish products directly to your Shopify store, and we'll handle the printing, embroidery, packing, and shipping. Unlike most POD platforms, North offers true print-on-demand embroidery alongside premium apparel, all manufactured in-house for exceptional quality, faster turnaround times, and a seamless merchant experience.
